tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring perfume / cologne on a plane?

travelTips: Fragrance bottles are typically made of glass, so wrap checked bottles carefully to avoid breakage.

faq.question: Is perfume / cologne allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Perfume / Cologne is restricted in carry-on luggage. Fragrances in liquid sprays are subject to the 3-1-1 liquids rule. Bottles in carry-on must be 3.4 oz or less. Larger bottles must be checked.

faq.question: Can you pack perfume / cologne in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Perfume / Cologne is allowed in checked bags.
